summary.title: Executive Summary — The Week in Numbers

blocks.label: The week in one line
blocks.text: Nifty 50 -2.36% · FPI equity +₹4,044 Cr · USD/INR 94.71 · Brent +6.24% · breadth downtrend.
FPIs: a net equity inflow of ₹4,044 Cr across 4 NSDL reporting days (3 of 4 positive); debt -₹2,448 Cr.
USD/INR 94.71 (+0.20%, rupee weaker); Brent $116.72 (+6.24%); India 10-year 7.46% (+9 bp); US 10-year 4.99% (-11 bp).
Nifty 50 -2.36% to 22,600.00, Midcap 150 -5.26%, Smallcap 250 -7.10% in the week to 23 Oct.

Of 1,521 coded names in the scan, 71 rose and 1,447 fell on the week (median -7.40%). Breadth regime: **downtrend**, with 12.9% above the 50-DMA and 32.6% above the 200-DMA (-32.1 and -22.1 points over four weeks).
Stage 2 by calculation (all 7 template checks): 118 names, 10 entered and 204 left since 16 Oct. The provider's Stage 2 list (701 names) was not updated this week (the list on file is dated 13 Sep).

SwingEdge sub-sector trackers: 0 of 32 trackers rose. Led by PSU Banks (-3.44%), Real Estate (-4.49%), Hotels (-4.58%); lagged by Battery Materials & Cells (-14.00%), Wires & Cables (-12.15%), Wind (-11.88%). The equal-weight market line: -7.41%.

blocks.label: How this report is built
blocks.text: Built automatically by `tools/auto_weekly.py` from data the evening pull already has: the screener.in scan, NSE's index file, NSDL's FPI Monitor, RBI's current rates, Yahoo closes, and SwingEdge's own breadth, Stage 2 and tracker files. No model writes any of it: each sentence is a template filled with the week's numbers. Not collected: DII daily flows and derivatives positioning (no keyless source). Facts only; nothing here rates a stock.
